claims.claim: Net revenue, unsold stock and fulfilment are shown first against the strongest of four baselines (including a rule-based dispatcher with a flat discount)
With elastic demand (1.5, set on screen) a discount is recommended only where the simulation adds money, with batch IDs and reason
Closing the biggest market rebuilds a feasible plan with zero rule breaks
Thirty random bad days: plan and strongest baseline both fixed in advance; the plan earns more on average
